title: ShortReading
description: His words read by script when they are numbers and letters only, as 1a 2b; otherwise short is false and a model reads them.

reading.description: What the owner's words say for one question of the turn.

question.description: The question's number on the turn card.

takes.description: choice: one of the question's choices; own: his own answer, his words; unsure: he does not know; pushback: he says the question is wrong.

letter.description: The choice, only when takes is choice.

words.description: His exact words for this question.
